# ataila_ai_usage (Data Source)

One tenant's AI gateway usage for a month, rated: totals, per key (and per tier and model under each key), per tier with its rate, per day, the month-end forecast and the monthly AI budget against the spend. EUR is rated when read — each day's tokens at the rate in force that day, the tenant's own rate (`ataila_ai_rate_plan`) else the list rate (`ataila_ai_rate_card`); a tier without a rate is null and named in `unrated_tiers`, and the totals are then a floor (`rated_complete` false). This is the operator's view: each key's attribution and the gateway's own shadow price (`shadow_usd`) are included. The usage ledger fills every 15 minutes, so today's figures grow. Needs a token holding `ai-gateway-read-global` or `orders-read-global` (or an admin key) and platform release 1.0.237 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This month (leave month out) or any earlier one.
data "ataila_ai_usage" "example" {
  tenant_id = "3f0c9a52-4d1e-4b8a-9d61-2f5b7e0c1a44"
  month     = "2026-10"
}

output "month_to_date" {
  value = {
    tokens   = data.ataila_ai_usage.example.totals.total_tokens
    eur      = data.ataila_ai_usage.example.rated_eur
    complete = data.ataila_ai_usage.example.rated_complete
    unpriced = data.ataila_ai_usage.example.unrated_tiers
    forecast = data.ataila_ai_usage.example.forecast.rated_eur
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant whose usage to read (`id` of an `ataila_tenant`).

### Optional

- `month` (String) The month, `YYYY-MM`, in the platform's billing time zone. Leave it out for the current month (the attribute then reads which month that was).

### Read-Only

- `budget` (Attributes) The monthly AI budget against the spend; null when the tenant has no `ai_budget_eur_month` quota. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget))
- `by_day` (Attributes List) Per billing day, from the first of the month to today (or the month's end). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_day))
- `by_key` (Attributes List) Per key, heaviest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_key))
- `by_tier` (Attributes List) Per serving tier, heaviest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_tier))
- `forecast` (Attributes) The month-end projection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forecast))
- `oldest_month` (String) The tenant's oldest month with usage, `YYYY-MM`; null when none.
- `rate_bases` (List of String) Every basis that priced something this month.
- `rate_basis` (String) Which rate priced it: `plan` (the tenant's own rate), `list` (the rate card), `contract_included` (an active contract includes metered AI: 0 EUR), `none` (no rate: not priced) or `pending` (the rates could not be read just now; usage is still shown). For the month: `plan` when any day used the tenant's own rate.
- `rated_complete` (Boolean) Every token was priced; false when a tier had no rate (a floor).
- `rated_eur` (Number) EUR at the tenant's rate on each day; null when nothing could be priced. When `rated_complete` is false it is a floor: the tiers without a rate add nothing.
- `tenant_name` (String) The tenant's display name.
- `tenant_slug` (String) The tenant's slug.
- `totals` (Attributes) The month's counts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--totals))
- `tz` (String) The billing time zone, e.g. `Europe/Budapest`.
- `unrated_tiers` (List of String) Tiers used this month that have no rate: not priced, so `rated_eur` is a floor.

<a id="nestedatt--budget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget`

Read-Only:

- `complete` (Boolean) False when `spent` is a floor (a tier had no rate).
- `enforced_on_gateway` (Boolean) True for `hard_cap`: the gateway stops the keys at the limit.
- `forecast` (Number) Projected EUR at month end.
- `forecast_pct` (Number) `forecast` as a percentage of `limit`.
- `limit` (Number) The budget, EUR per month.
- `pct` (Number) `spent` as a percentage of `limit`.
- `policy` (String) The quota's policy: `auto` and `approve_always` alert only; `hard_cap` stops the tenant's keys on the gateway at the limit.
- `spent` (Number) Rated EUR this month; null when not known.
- `state` (String) `ok`, `warn` (80 % or more), `reached` (100 % or more) or `unknown`.


<a id="nestedatt--by_day"></a>
### Nested Schema for `by_day`

Read-Only:

- `calls` (Number) Calls.
- `day` (String) The billing day (in the billing time zone, `tz`).
- `rated_eur` (Number) EUR at the tenant's rate on each day; null when nothing could be priced. When `rated_complete` is false it is a floor: the tiers without a rate add nothing.
- `shadow_usd` (Number) The AI gateway's own price in USD (its shadow price, used for budget enforcement on the gateway). Not the bill: the bill is `rated_eur`.
- `total_tokens` (Number) Tokens.


<a id="nestedatt--by_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `by_key`

Read-Only:

- `app` (String) Its application, when known.
- `attribution` (String) How the key was tied to its tenant: `registry` (a registered key), `map` (an operator's mapping), `project` (the key's project) or `unattributed`.
- `env` (String) Its environment (`dev`, `uat`, `prod`), when known.
- `key_alias` (String) The key's alias (never its value).
- `last_seen` (String) Its last call in the month. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `project_id` (String) Its project (`id` on a project), when known.
- `rated_eur` (Number) EUR at the tenant's rate on each day; null when nothing could be priced. When `rated_complete` is false it is a floor: the tiers without a rate add nothing.
- `rows` (Attributes List) Its usage per tier and model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_key--rows))
- `totals` (Attributes) Its counts for the month. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_key--totals))

Read-Only:

- `completion_tokens` (Number) Output tokens.
- `failures` (Number) Calls that failed (refused or errored).
- `model` (String) The model that served it.
- `prompt_tokens` (Number) Input tokens.
- `rate_basis` (String) Which rate priced it: `plan` (the tenant's own rate), `list` (the rate card), `contract_included` (an active contract includes metered AI: 0 EUR), `none` (no rate: not priced) or `pending` (the rates could not be read just now; usage is still shown).
- `rated_complete` (Boolean) Every token was priced; false when a tier had no rate (a floor).
- `rated_eur` (Number) EUR at the tenant's rate on each day; null when nothing could be priced. When `rated_complete` is false it is a floor: the tiers without a rate add nothing.
- `shadow_usd` (Number) The AI gateway's own price in USD (its shadow price, used for budget enforcement on the gateway). Not the bill: the bill is `rated_eur`.
- `tier` (String) The serving tier, e.g. `general`, `code`, `embed`.
- `total_tokens` (Number) Input and output tokens together.
